rows.note: Use this when “input” means someone’s opinion, advice, or feedback rather than technical data.

example.english: We want everyone's input before the meeting.
example.traditional: 我哋開會之前想聽吓大家嘅意見。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hoi1 wui2 zi1 cin4 soeng2 teng1 haa5 daai6 gaa1 ge3 ji3 gin3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose technical term for putting data into a system or process.

example.english: Before you input the data into the system, remember to check it carefully.
example.traditional: 將資料輸入系統之前，記得先核對清楚。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 zi1 liu2 syu1 jap6 hai6 tung2 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 sin1 hat6 deoi3 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the input jack or port on a device.

example.english: The input jack on this speaker is at the back.
example.traditional: 呢部喇叭嘅輸入插口喺後面。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 laa3 baa1 ge3 syu1 jap6 caap3 hau2 hai2 hau6 min6
